title: Gherkin PowerTools Suppressions
description: Configuration file for suppressing BDD anti-pattern findings.

ruleId.description: The ID of the rule to suppress (e.g., 'oversized-scenario').

uri.description: Glob pattern or exact URI path for the files this suppression applies to.

scopeType.description: Optional structural scope type to limit the suppression.

scopeValue.description: The exact name or text of the structure.

reason.description: Mandatory explanation for why this technical debt is being accepted.

by.description: The user who created the suppression.
